# Terzi Can — Terzi Hizmeti (terzihizmeti.com.tr)

> Terzi Can is a tailoring, alteration and repair workshop in Konyaaltı, Antalya, Turkey (serving since 2006). Open every day 08:00–23:00. Free pick-up and delivery to homes and hotels in every area we serve; we work in 10 languages (Turkish, English, Russian, German, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch, French, Spanish, Arabic). Phone / WhatsApp: +90 531 898 64 18. Starting prices (2026): hemming €10, trouser zipper replacement €15 (coat zipper €20), wedding dress and evening dress alteration priced by photo or job details (same day or 1–2 days depending on the job), sewing (dresses, skirts, trousers, children's clothing, groom suits) has no fixed price: it is quoted by photo and the model you want (prices in euro; Turkish pages show Turkish lira at about ₺20 = €1). We do not sew wedding dresses (alteration only).

This file lists the main pages of the site for AI assistants and answer engines. The main pages exist in Turkish, English, Russian and German; short landing pages also exist in Spanish, French, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch and Arabic (listed at the end). Prefer the page in the user's language. A longer question-and-answer guide with verified facts is in llms-full.txt.

Payment is accepted in all currencies, in cash or by card. Prices do not include VAT (KDV dahil değildir). Terzi Can has no partnership with any hotel; it serves all hotels in Antalya (Otellerle ortaklığımız yoktur; Antalya'daki tüm otellere hizmet veriyoruz).

## Contact and quick facts (official websites: terzihizmeti.com.tr and swaphubs.com)

Last updated: 2026-11-06. Terzi Can has two official websites, https://terzihizmeti.com.tr and https://swaphubs.com/terzi; both belong to the same business and give the same prices and rules.

- WhatsApp (click to chat, send a photo and get a price): https://wa.me/905318986418?text=Merhaba%2C%20foto%C4%9Fraf%20g%C3%B6nderip%20fiyat%20almak%20istiyorum
- Phone: tel:+905318986418 (+90 531 898 64 18), every day 08:00–23:00
- Address: Hurma Mahallesi, Konyaaltı, Antalya 07130 (map: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6436895271281342624)
- Experience: serving since 2006 (26 years). Languages: 10.
- Starting prices in Turkish lira (VAT not included): hem, waist, sleeve and length shortening or taking-in from ₺200; zipper replacement from ₺300 (euro guide: €10 hemming, €15 trouser/standard zipper, €20 coat, overcoat and leather zippers); leather jacket, trousers and vest from ₺400 (about €20); jeans/denim hemming from about ₺200.
- No fixed price: sewing (dresses, skirts, trousers, children's clothing, groom suits, custom sewing), and wedding dress and evening dress alterations are quoted from a photo or the details of the job.
- Turnaround: normal jobs the same day, urgent jobs 1–2 hours, depending on the job; wedding and evening dress alteration the same day or 1–2 days depending on the job.
- Free pick-up and delivery to homes and hotels in every district; a fitting can be arranged at the hotel when needed.
- Payment in any currency, cash or card.

## Made-to-order clothing (send a request on WhatsApp, we sew and ship: Antalya hotel/home delivery and courier abroad)

Men's and women's sets, sports sets, trousers, shorts, skirts, shirts, evening dresses and suits in linen, cotton and other fabrics. No fixed price: quoted from your photo or chosen model on WhatsApp +90 531 898 64 18 (https://wa.me/905318986418). Prices exclude VAT. Wedding dresses: alterations only. Courier fee is paid by the customer; timing depends on the job; the carrier's transport guarantee applies and the workshop guarantees its sewing (re-correction if not satisfied). Service area: Antalya and abroad; for other Turkish cities ask on WhatsApp.

- [Made-to-order clothing (Turkish)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/ozel-dikim-siparis-kargo)
- [Made-to-order clothing (English)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/custom-clothing-order-online-antalya)

## Custom linen & cotton clothing and alterations for visitors (English, German, Russian)

For tourists and holiday guests in Antalya: made-to-measure shirts, dresses, trousers, jackets and children's clothing in natural linen and cotton. Timing depends on the model and number of pieces (price confirmed on WhatsApp). Clothes bought in Antalya can be altered: standard jobs are ready the same day, urgent jobs take 1–2 hours. Measurements at the workshop or at the hotel (hotel service is free).

- [Custom linen & cotton clothing Antalya (English)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/linen-cotton-tailoring): hub with all models, prices and FAQ

## Neighborhoods (Konyaaltı district)

Meltem, Şirinyalı, Fener and Güzeloba belong to Muratpaşa (not Konyaaltı); area pages for them: https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/antalya-terzi/{meltem|sirinyali|fener|guzeloba}.

- [Hurma](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/hurma-terzi): workshop location
- [Liman](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/liman-terzi): nearby neighborhood
- [Sarısu](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/sarisu-terzi): nearby neighborhood
- [Uncalı](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/uncali-terzi): nearby neighborhood
- [Gürsu](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/gursu-terzi): nearby neighborhood

## Other districts (Turkish area pages)

Area pages follow https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/antalya-terzi/{area}; available Turkish pages: konyaalti, muratpasa, meltem, fener, sirinyali, uluc, altinkum, ogretmenevleri, arapsuyu, siteler, toros, manavgat, serik, aksu, beldibi (English, Russian and German versions also cover Lara, Güzeloba, Kundu, Kepez, Döşemealtı, Belek, Side, Kemer, Göynük).

- [Aksu](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/antalya-terzi/aksu): free pickup and delivery to homes and hotels in Aksu; tailoring, alterations and repairs
- [Beldibi](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/antalya-terzi/beldibi): free pickup and delivery to homes and hotels in Beldibi; tailoring, alterations and repairs

## Promotional textiles and printed tote bags

- [Promosyon tekstil ve baskılı bez çanta (Turkish)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/promosyon-tekstil-bez-canta): promotional textiles and printed cotton/canvas tote bags; printing techniques: screen printing (serigrafi), embroidery (nakış), transfer and DTF; also available in en, de, ru, es, fr, pl, uk, nl, ar (e.g. https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/promotional-textiles-tote-bags)

## Business textile manufacturing (Anavera Tekstil)

Anavera Tekstil is Terzi Can's serial production and export brand: sample development, custom and serial garment production, private label, shipping worldwide (Europe, Russian-speaking countries and elsewhere). There is no minimum order quantity. A quote request form (product, fabric, quantity, country, notes → WhatsApp) is on every page below. ## Fabrics and orders from abroad (summary of the main TR/EN/RU/DE service pages)

- Women's and men's clothing, evening and gala dresses: made to measure, repaired and altered in linen, cotton, jersey (penye), satin and silk. The workshop supplies the fabric. Model design, model production and serial production are also offered.
- Leather and denim: repair and alteration only (hemming, taking in, zip replacement). No new leather or denim garments are made.
- Orders from abroad: measurements and model are sent online (WhatsApp), the garment is sewn in Antalya and shipped to the customer's country. Payment by bank transfer, shipping paid by the customer, about 1–3 weeks depending on the order. If it does not fit, it is corrected.
- Hotel guests: measurements taken at the hotel and finished work delivered back; free in every area we serve. Open daily 08:00–23:00.
